## Walkthrough This PR adds RHEL 10 support to driver-toolkit by upgrading the Dockerfile base image from OCP 4.22 to OCP 5.0, introducing a new RHEL10-specific ImageStream manifest, and updating image reference tags to use the `driver-toolkit-10` variant throughout the build and deployment configurations. ## Changes **RHEL 10 driver-toolkit support** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **Dockerfile base image and manifest updates**
`Dockerfile.rhel10` | Base image upgraded from OCP 4.22 to OCP 5.0 (RHEL9 base); Dockerfile now copies and references the RHEL10-specific ImageStream manifest (`01-openshift-imagestream-rhel10.yaml`); container label `name` value changed from `driver-toolkit` to `driver-toolkit-10`. | | **RHEL10 ImageStream manifest**
`manifests/01-openshift-imagestream-rhel10.yaml` | New OpenShift `ImageStream` resource for the openshift namespace, defining two tags (`latest-rhel-10` and `0.0.1-snapshot-machine-os`) configured to import from `driver-toolkit-10` Docker image reference with scheduled imports and `PreserveOriginal` policy. | | **Image reference and tag updates**
`manifests/image-references-rhel10`, `manifests/01-openshift-imagestream.yaml` | Image reference tag replaced from `driver-toolkit` to `driver-toolkit-10` with updated DockerImage reference; ImageStream tag entry formatting adjusted. | ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes
